changes_vs_current: Out: Stranger Things (avg 41.3), The Leftovers (31.3, #26, with The Americans 31.0 just outside), Severance (37.5, one eligible source), Yellowstone, Ozark, Peaky Blinders, House of the Dragon (few or no hits); Lost drops from #9 to #23; new entrants: The Twilight Zone, Fargo, The X-Files, Battlestar Galactica, Downton Abbey, Sherlock, The Shield.
confidence: medium. Top 3 (Sopranos, Breaking Bad, Wire) is very solid across all four sources. Weak points: three of four sources are critic/industry lists, drama-only ordinals are my own filtering (classification of Twilight Zone, Sherlock, Fargo as dramas is a judgment call), and IMDb's chart is rating-weighted so mass-audience hits (Lost, Yellowstone, Stranger Things) are under-credited. Positions 19-24 are separated by under 3 points and would reshuffle with a fifth source. Not used: TVLine 2023 (editorial, not a poll) and YouGov/CBS 2020 favorite-shows list (broadcast/game-show heavy, little drama signal).
